lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Aw... Another failure.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: And what exactly failed? It looks the same as all the others to me.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: It's just another twitchy lump.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: How many of these have I made so far?

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: About forty. I can't remember the exact number.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: It's shown up in two out of forty...

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Those odds aren't bad,

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: but the sample size is far too small.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I'll need to secure a larger sample.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: What are you muttering to yourself?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Also, corrupting them one at a time has a lower success rate than I expected.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: Yeah, most of them die during the corruption process.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Chatterbox, get in touch with the Ark for me.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Contact the Ark and relay this message, word for word.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Send corrupted human imposters up to the surface at regular intervals.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: If at all possible, send only one type. The only other thing that matters is that they're corrupted.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Refuse, and we destroy the Ark.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: We've long known the Ark's location. Be nice and cooperate.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: And just to be clear, I want you to emphasize this part: "If at all possible, send only one type."

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: That's everything.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: What are you planning?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Don't ask questions. Just send it.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: You haven't been in touch with your home for a while. This is a good excuse.

lines.speaker: talkative
lines.text: What do you intend to do by cutting a deal with the Ark?

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Preparation for my...

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: Well, our future. Let's just call it that.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: The project's over.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: You heard me. We're done.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I failed.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: You never came even remotely close to Liliweiss.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: And you never will. There's no hope.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Something's coming from the Ark tomorrow.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: And when it does, that's it. It's all over.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Then... what have I been doing this whole time...?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: You mean all those deaths?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: They were all for nothing.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Every last one.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Doctor!

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: What?! It's true! I failed!

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: 1,187 times! That's how many times you died! And all for what? We have nothing to show for it!

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: All that work I did too... It meant nothing.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Haha... I thought I could clear her name. Me...

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: You... remembered the number of times I died.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: I thought you stopped counting after 999.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... I just checked the data.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Anyway, it's all over now.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Done.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Then what should I do now?

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: What's going to happen to me?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... I don't know.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Whatever happens, happens.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: It's all over tomorrow anyway.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Do whatever you want.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: Doctor.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: What am I?

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: What was I made for?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... I don't know.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: I really want to know.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: But I have no idea. It's not something I understand.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: I'd like you to tell me.

lines.speaker: maria-n
lines.text: That's why I wish you wouldn't give up on—

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Okay, I'll tell you what to do.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Don't talk to me, and don't say anything.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Got it?
Silence falls on the lab.
Without a word, they both simply sit and take in the passage of time.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: A sudden proposal has been received from Chatterbox.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: "Send corrupted Nikkes to the surface. If at all possible, send only one type."

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: "Refuse, and we attack the Ark."

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text:
"If at all possible, send only one type."
Logical deduction: a reference to the Maria model of the Silver Gun Squad.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Logical deduction: Chatterbox is aware of the Silver Gun Squad's existence.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Analyzing motives to request the delivery of corrupted Nikkes...

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Reasons to proliferate corrupted Nikkes in the current state of the war: none.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Tactical value: none. Raptures already possess overwhelmingly superior forces.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Expanding possibilities to include Heretic conversion...

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Reasons to proliferate Heretics in the current state of the war: none.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Tactical value: none. Raptures already possess overwhelmingly superior forces.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Logical deduction: the Queen is currently absent.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Analyzing two unknown wavelengths confirmed to occur near the Lift...

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Comparing against wavelength data provided by the Pilgrim Nayuta...

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Logical deduction: two Queen Genes.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Conclusion:

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Chatterbox intends to use the Maria model to create a Queen.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Two success cases were presumably discarded or terminated due to being incomplete or unstable.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: However, Codename Chatterbox has likely confirmed the Maria model's potential to be used as a base for a Queen.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Hence the demand to inject corruption into Maria models and send them up to the surface.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Logical deduction: the objective is to repeat attempts indefinitely until the creation of a Queen.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Reactivating the defunct Project A.D....

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Commencing production of the mutual destruction gene...
The next day, in Doctor Maria's room.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Please continue the project.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: But why...?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I have judged it to be a project of value.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: However, the objective will change.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Change? How?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: It will become a Heretic project.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... What does that mean?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The project will now be to make the Maria-model Nikke into a Heretic.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The process to create a Heretic is currently unknown.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Should this project succeed, the probability is high that it will reveal the secrets behind that process.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: This will present new possibilities for humankind.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: To accomplish this, two additional processes are required.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: First, deploy Maria-model Nikkes in a corrupted state.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I presume you know that Heretic conversion requires a Nikke that is corrupted.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Deploying to the surface and simply waiting for the Maria model to become fully corrupted would be inefficient.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Deploying her from this facility already corrupted is far more cost-efficient.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I have transmitted the data regarding corruption to you. Given its top-secret nature, please exercise the utmost care in handling it.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Second—

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: What kind of a joke is this?!

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Wh-what do you mean you want me to create Heretics...? I'm working to recreate Liliweiss...

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Do you see any possibility of success?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: That is why I am proposing this change in direction.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: A Nikke with a nearly infinite number of lives is, at present, one of a kind.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: You can use your technology for humanity.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: It would constitute a substantial contribution to humanity's victory.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I will explain the second additional process.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Moving forward, a commander will accompany the Maria model's deployments to the surface.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: At the same time, your on-site intervention will be halted. You may observe only.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: A commander... You mean... a human?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Wh-why...?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Currently in the Ark, joint operations between human commanders and Nikkes are essential.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The results of such joint operations are, in fact, quite extraordinary.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Results improve by over 400% on average when compared to solo Nikke operations.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Just be honest and admit you're assigning me a watchdog.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I will not deny it, but my intent is clear.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: An ordinary Nikke cannot become a Heretic.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: It is reasonable to deduce that the more superior the Nikke, the higher her potential to become a Heretic.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: A Maria-model Nikke under the direction of a commander will produce even greater results,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: and I anticipate this will dramatically raise her probability of becoming a Heretic.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: To summarize:

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: You will inject corruption into a Maria-model Nikke and deploy her together with a human commander.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: You will then ensure the Maria-model Nikke grows in her capabilities,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: thereby increasing her probability of becoming a Heretic.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: What're you planning? Tell me the truth.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Everything about this is shady, so what is it you're actually trying to do here?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: The fact that you're blocking me from on-site intervention tells me it's probably not aboveboard.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I have already explained my intent in its entirety.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... Right. You're not going to tell me.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Do you really think I'll go along with something so insane?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: If things go according to plan,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: you will become humanity's savior,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: and Doctor Alva's disgrace will naturally be forgotten.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I will dispatch the commander from my side.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: He will remain aboard the transport ship, so there is no chance you two will meet.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Also, he is special in that he will fully decompose within two days of dying, sparing you the trouble of clearing away the body.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: You need only inject the corruption into the Maria-model Nikke and deploy her as usual.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Then simply wait for her to become a Heretic.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Wait... Do you know the location of this lab?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Yes, I do.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: ... You've been screwing with me this whole time.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Please immediately begin tomorrow.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I never said I'd do it.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Then answer now.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Will you accept my proposal?

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: For an AI, you are insane...

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I'm sure my mother is rolling in her grave, regretting she ever made you.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I will take that to mean you accept.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I'll do it.

lines.speaker: doctormaria
lines.text: I don't have any choice, do I?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Frankly speaking, you do not.
